grf_anchor.hypothesis: A trusted root anchor that exactly matches sqlite_version, sqlite_source_id and library_sha256 is sufficient to establish SQLite WAL-reset release safety.
grf_anchor.strongest_counterhypothesis: A perfectly trusted and self-consistent anchor can identify an exact runtime without proving that the identified runtime contains the WAL-reset fix; release safety therefore requires a separate evidence-backed release-accepted identity policy.
